name: slider
title: Slider
description: Drag a thumb along a track to set a value. Ranges, volume, and continuous settings.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.how: 0 for percentages; set to business min for money/quantity. Default: 0.
100 for %; match the product ceiling. Must be > min. Default: 100.

configurables.what: Snap increment for keyboard and drag.
configurables.how: 1 for integers; 0.1/0.01 for fine controls. Default: 1.
true when prerequisites are unmet. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Expose the value in text nearby or aria-valuetext; keep min/max/step consistent with the visible unit.
Controlled: value + onValueChange; uncontrolled: defaultValue. Values are numbers (or number[] if multi-thumb patterns are used).

agent.usage:
import { Slider } from '@/components/atoms/Slider';

<Slider min={0} max={100} step={5} value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} />
